content.snl: variable(__list__(Type.annotation(@$\mathbb{K}$,Type),Type.annotation(@V,Type),LA.Field($\mathbb{K}$),LA.VectorSpace(V,$\mathbb{K}$),Type.annotation(@ι,Type),Type.annotation(@hord,$\mathrm{LinearOrder}\ \iota$),Type.annotation(@f,Type.to(ι,V)),Type.annotation(@n,ι),Type.annotation(@hIP,InnerProductSpace($\mathbb{K}$,V))),def(gramSchmidtNormed($\mathbb{K}$,f,n),,$\widehat{g}_n = \|g_n\|^{-1} g_n;\quad f \text{ linearly independent} \Rightarrow \{\widehat{g}_n\} \text{ is orthonormal}$))

values.zh-CN: 规范化：$\widehat{g}_n=\|g_n\|^{-1}g_n$（$g_n=0$ 时约定为 $0$）。当 $f$ 线性无关时 $g_n\ne 0$，该族规范正交且与 $f$ 张成相同的滤子。
values.en: Normalisation: $\widehat{g}_n=\|g_n\|^{-1}g_n$ (taken as $0$ when $g_n=0$). When $f$ is linearly independent the $g_n$ are nonzero, and the family is orthonormal with the same spans as $f$.
